normalized_rule: Phaladeepika names six strength components—Kalaja, Cheshta, Uccha, Dik, Ayana, and Sthana—as a source taxonomy; numerical implementations are not encoded here.
synthesis_notes: The rule preserves Mantreswara's shadbala vocabulary without importing BPHS or Parashari implementation details.
review_notes: The six named components are a taxonomy, not a claim that this batch supplies all numerical formulas. This is a source taxonomy; no numeric Shadbala engine is implied.
